name: Scorchridge V2 - Side Scrolling
author: in254 Team
description: Side-scrolling prison colony management. Walk the hallways as warden IN-254, manage 20 inmates in individual bunkers, assign ore tiers, ration PCHO, and meet OvAI's relentless quotas. A reimagined Scorchridge experience with horizontal scrolling, two-level bunker layout, and cell-based gameplay.
